findings.title: Rate Limiting Integration Tests Broken - Missing Function
findings.summary: Tests reference non-existent createRateLimiter function. All rate limiting integration tests fail.
findings.failure_scenario: Test calls createRateLimiter() which is not exported from rate limiting module. Test fails with TypeError.
affected_tests: login endpoint enforces 5 req/min limit per IP
findings.impact: Cannot verify rate limiting is working. Risk of deploying to production without validation.
findings.fix: Update test imports to use createRateLimitMiddleware instead of createRateLimiter

findings.title: JWT Secret Rotation Not Implemented
findings.summary: JWT_SECRET has no rotation mechanism. Compromised keys remain valid indefinitely.
findings.failure_scenario: If JWT_SECRET is leaked, an attacker gains permanent access until manual secret change and redeployment.
findings.impact: Leaked secrets provide unlimited access to the system without automatic remediation.
findings.recommendation: Implement 90-day secret rotation with support for multiple active keys during transition period.
findings.configuration: Requires deployment pipeline changes and key management strategy

findings.title: Sensitive Field Redaction Missing in Error Logging
findings.summary: Error logs may contain sensitive fields like passwords, tokens, or API keys when errors occur.
findings.failure_scenario: During development, an authentication error could expose password hashes or JWT tokens in log output.
findings.impact: Development team could accidentally view sensitive data in error logs.
findings.environment: Development only (production logs are safer due to NODE_ENV check)
findings.recommendation: Add automatic redaction for common sensitive fields: password, token, secret, key, apiKey, authorization
findings.fix_complexity: Simple - Add field filtering utility in formatErrorLog()

findings.title: Non-Cryptographic Random Generation Documentation Unclear
findings.summary: generateRandomSuffix() uses Math.random() but lacks clear documentation on appropriate use.
findings.failure_scenario: Developer might use generateRandomSuffix() for security-critical operations instead of crypto.randomBytes().
findings.impact: Potential misuse of non-secure random generation for sensitive purposes.
findings.implementation: Function correctly uses Math.random() for non-security purposes, but intent is unclear
findings.recommendation: Add prominent JSDoc warning: @deprecated - Only for non-security purposes (UI IDs, non-auth tokens). Use crypto.randomBytes for security-critical values.

findings.title: Rate Limiting Configuration Needs Documentation
findings.summary: Per-endpoint rate limits are configured but not documented in API specification.
findings.impact: API consumers unaware of rate limits, may hit limits unexpectedly
findings.recommendation: Document all rate limit configurations in OpenAPI/Swagger spec

production_readiness: READY WITH CAVEATS - Fix test suite and implement JWT rotation before production
next_steps: Add sensitive field redaction to error logging (BEFORE PRODUCTION)
